basic_info.name: Reflex
basic_info.description: For years, companies had two options: generic SaaS that forced the business to conform, or custom development that required a large engineering team. AI removes that constraint. Reflex turns your business needs, knowledge, and data into production software that uses AI to help your business run more effectively, no matter what systems you use today.Use our platform directly, or work with our forward-deployed teams to figure out which systems your business needs and ship them. The resulting applications are software you can edit, connect to existing systems, and run in your own environment.Reflex standardizes the stack, from the framework developers write in to how apps are deployed and maintained. Your team can use the same tools for applications across the organization, connected to existing systems and running on your infrastructure.
